topic: it's never too late to start
lines: #You think it's too *late.*
Too late to change careers. Too late to *learn.*
Too late to start *over.*
#But here's a question.
How old will you be in five *years* if you don't start?
Exactly the same age as if you *do.*
#Time is going to pass *anyway.*
The only difference is what you have to *show* for it.
#There are people who started at forty. At *fifty.* At sixty.
People who learned to read later in *life.*
Who built something new after everyone said they were *done.*
They weren't special. They just stopped believing the *clock.*
#Your age is not a *wall.*
It's *experience.*
You know things now that you didn't know at *twenty.*
You've survived things that taught you *patience.*
That's not a weakness. That's a *head start.*
#So stop counting how many years you have *left.*
Start counting what you can *build* with them.
The best time was years ago.
#The next best time is *tonight.*
end: Send this to someone who thinks it's too late.
